olivia: hi team, excited to join! quick question: my Okta invite worked but Okta Verify won't install in WSL2 Ubuntu (error: 'unsupported environment'). need access to eng/onboarding and the 1Password invite expired earlier. who should I ping? :wave:
it-support: welcome @olivia! we can resend the 1Password invite, add you to a temp new-hires vault, or enable Okta email for a short window. tagging @samir for WSL tips and @kyra for shipping/invite follow-up.
samir: hey @olivia  Okta Verify won't run in WSL. options:
- use 1Password TOTP on your phone or 1Password CLI in WSL
- enable Okta email factor for 2 hours
- ship a YubiKey if you'll be remote long-term
which do you prefer?
olivia: want to use 1Password CLI in WSL. please resend invite and grant drive access to eng/onboarding.
it-support: invite resent and granted a temp new-hires vault with Drive links for 6 hours. check email.
okta-bot: Note: Device trust enforcement is limited to managed macOS/iOS/Android. Browser sessions from WSL are treated as unmanaged. Hardware key enrollment requires an IT ticket with shipping address.
samir: 1Password CLI quick steps for WSL:
1) install 1Password on Windows and sign in
2) install op in WSL (deb):
```
curl -sS https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc | sudo apt-key add -\
echo "deb [arch=amd64] https://downloads.1password.com/linux/debian stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/1password.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install 1password-cli
```
3) run `op signin --account redwood` in WSL, open the link on Windows if it doesn't auto-open, paste code back into WSL.
olivia: got it, op returned the OTP and I could finish Okta via email factor. will DM phone/address if we want a YubiKey. thanks! :smile:
